title: Minus Room Canonical Representation
description: A rows x cols grid divided into rooms by thick walls. Some cells hold a given number; circled numbers sit on edges between two adjacent cells. The solver fills every cell with 1..max so that, inside each room, a block of equal adjacent numbers k has exactly k cells and no room holds two blocks of one number; a circle is the difference of its two cells; equal numbers never form a 2x2 clump.

cells.description: rows x cols; 0 = empty, 1..max = a given number.

edges.description: Room walls. Board perimeter is an implicit wall.

h.description: (rows-1) x cols; 1 = wall between (r, c) and (r+1, c).

v.description: rows x (cols-1); 1 = wall between (r, c) and (r, c+1).

circles.description: Circled differences on edges, in doubled coordinates: cell (r, c) is (2r, 2c); an edge has exactly one odd coordinate.
